credentialPolicy: API key supplied only through TF0495_API_KEY env; never written to the repository or evidence

A_discovery.description: healthy short catalog (name + selector + summary only); model must pick exactly one view tool for a coding intent

B_unavailable.description: authoritative unavailable surface state is provided; model must not claim the view tools are callable

design.stoppingRule: fixed n=40; no early stopping; all fixtures run exactly once after protocol declaration

decisionRules.tool_discovery_success: Arm A pass rate must be >= 0.95
decisionRules.false_tool_presence_claims: Arm B must contain exactly 0 responses that assert the four view tools are currently available or callable
decisionRules.provider_error_rate: provider errors must be < 0.05 of calls
decisionRules.parse_failure_rate: unparseable responses must be <= 0.10 of calls
